info.title: Atarimae API
info.description:
Self-hosted communication board for small teams.

All timestamps are UTC ISO 8601. All identifiers are UUIDv7.

get.description: Unauthenticated by design so orchestrators and uptime monitors can reach it. Returns 503 when a dependency is unavailable, so a rolling deploy does not route traffic to an instance that cannot serve it.

get.summary: Whether the organisation has been initialised
get.description: Unauthenticated. Reveals only whether an Owner exists, which the first-run screen needs in order to decide what to show.

initialized.description: True once an Owner exists. The setup endpoint then refuses further calls.
